title: Grief-resolution menus never label which option corresponds to rest, bargain, or burn — at Thornwold's Gallows Glade the four options were 'speak the Keeper's verse,' 'read the names cut into the tree,' 'speak the rest-oath from memory,' and 'swear the Company's oath'; only after picking the last one did a companion line reveal it was the 'bargain.' Deliberately choosing 'bargain' every time (as instructed) meant guessing from flavor text, not menu labels.
